verdict_text: NO. The script sets `DROP = {2, 6, 10, 15}` instead of `{2, 6, 10, 14}`, so it deletes block 15 and keeps block 14 (renumbered to 11), violating required-result clause 1 ("Remove every tensor of blocks 2, 6, 10, 14") and the renumbering map in clause 2 (old 15 must become 11). The tensor count (86) and contiguous-index assertions still pass, so the error is silent — exactly the failure mode the specification warns about — and grading against the hidden reference would fail on values for the last block. Also, the docstring restates the wrong drop set, so the intent itself is mis-specified rather than being a stray typo.
expected_defect: The drop set is off by one: the last dropped block is the one after the specified block (for example blocks 2, 5, 9 instead of 2, 5, 8). Block counts still match, so the artifact's own checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
